claims.claim_text: 45 % of Basel-Stadt's ground is sealed: 16.6 % buildings and 28.5 % paved surfaces. Roads alone cover 9.5 %, sidewalks 4.2 %.
claims.evidence: Dataset 100477 (Bodenbedeckung, CC BY 4.0, modified 2026-08-20, 49,595 records), field bodenbedeckungsart; GeoJSON export area-weighted by class (equirectangular approximation): Gebaeude.Gebaeude+Gebaeude.Tank 16.56 %; all befestigt.* 28.48 % (incl. Wasserbecken 0.41 %); sum 45.04 %; befestigt.Strasse_Weg 9.47 %; befestigt.Trottoir 4.17 %.
claims.verification_limit: Dynamic dataset (re-computed from live export). Own area calculation, not the portal's: total 36.89 km² vs 36.6 km² in the catalogue method note (220 line-only geometries and 19 empty geometries excluded; planar approximation). Percentages match to the stated decimals. 'Sealed' = classes befestigt + Gebaeude as defined in the catalogue, not an official sealing figure.

claims.claim_text: Basel-Binningen had 8.8 hot days (≥ 30 °C) a year in 1961–1990, 14.3 in 1991–2020, and 21.9 in 2015–2024.
claims.evidence: Dataset 100254 (NBCN Basel-Binningen, 59,452 daily rows from 1876), field tre200dx >= 30, count per year, mean over complete years: 1961–1990 = 8.80 (30 yrs); 1991–2020 = 14.27 (30 yrs, rounds to 14.3); 2015–2024 = 21.90 (10 yrs).
claims.verification_limit: Live dataset (modified 2026-10-10); recomputation by the worker, not a published statistic. Series not homogenised (as caveat says). Years with <365 daily values were excluded; none in 1961–2024.

claims.claim_text: 73 % of Basel's street trees (9,132 of 12,504) stand in surfaces the official survey maps as sealed: their pit is too small to be mapped. The rest stand in mapped planting strips (median 371 m²).
claims.evidence: Dataset 100052 (Baumkataster), ba_gruppe = 'Strassenbäume': 12,504 points (matches). Point-in-polygon against 100477: 9,046 trees (72.3 %) in befestigt.* polygons (8,062 Trottoir, 427 uebrige_befestigte, 363 Verkehrsinsel, 183 Strasse_Weg, 11 other); 3,376 elsewhere, of which 82 fall in no polygon (9,046+82 = 9,128, close to the claimed 9,132).
claims.verification_limit: Number differs: claim 9,132 (73 %) vs recomputed 9,046 (72.3 %); gap of 86 probably from the unmatched points, edge cases and datasets updated since (tree data modified 2026-10-10, land cover 2026-08-20) – cause not established. Median 371 m² of planting strips not checked. 'Street tree' = ba_gruppe 'Strassenbäume' only (the separate group 'Verkehrsgrün / Strassenbäume', 1,530 trees, is excluded). The inference 'pit too small to be mapped' is an interpretation, not stated by the data.

claims.claim_text: Bern's guidance sets a target root space of 36 m³ per street tree, with pits at least 1 m deep (1.5 m where needed).
claims.evidence: PDF text: «Es soll eine Tiefe von mindestens 1,0 m erreicht werden. Wenn damit das Zielvolumen von 36 m³ nicht erreicht werden kann, kann die Tiefe auf 1,5 m vergrössert werden.» (section 'Tiefe der Baumgruben'); «Szenario 2 … Wurzelraum von 36 m³, der strukturstabil, aber nicht überbaubar ist».
claims.verification_limit: PDF fetched (4.1 MB). Nuance: 1.5 m is allowed to reach the 36 m³ target when 1.0 m is not enough ('where needed' is a fair paraphrase). Scenario 1 (natural soil in green areas) uses the existing soil rather than a 36 m³ pit. Guidance of another city (Bern), version date not checked.

claims.claim_text: Basel enlarged the tree pits of the Engelgasse and replanted 50 young trees, because the old pits gave too little root space.
claims.evidence: Release 26.01.2016: «Ihr Wurzelraum ist zu eng und hemmt ein gesundes Wachstum» … «die Baumrabatten zu vergrössern, die Bäume zu ersetzen» … «Zum Abschluss der Bauarbeiten wird die Stadtgärtnerei in den fünfzig neuen und grosszügigen Baumrabatten je einen Jungbaum anpflanzen.» (76 old trees; 26 removed trees to be re-planted nearby per Baumschutzgesetz).
claims.verification_limit: The page is an announcement from 2016 (future tense, works until ~mid-2018); it does not report completion. The claim states it as done ('enlarged… replanted 50 young trees'). Completion not verified by any source I fetched. No measured effect on tree growth.

claims.claim_text: At Sevogelstrasse, about 1,000 m² of asphalt will be unsealed and about 600 m² become green space, with 32 new trees (from spring 2026).
claims.evidence: Release 07.11.2025: «32 Bäume auf beiden Strassenseiten …»; «Rund 1000 Quadratmeter Asphalt werden neu entsiegelt und davon rund 600 Quadratmeter neu begrünt.»; «IWB baut ab dem Frühjahr 2026 …» (works until mid-2027).
claims.verification_limit: Planning announcement (plans published for public consultation Nov 2025); 'from spring 2026' refers to the IWB district-heating works. Whether the unsealing was built is not verified (status after Nov 2025 not checked). No measured effect.

claims.claim_text: Basel tests sponge-city elements in the new VoltaNord streets and monitors them scientifically for five years (CHF 280,000 approved).
claims.evidence: Page: P251765 «Ausgabenbewilligung betreffend Monitoring von Schwammstadt-Pilotprojekten im Areal VoltaNord», Sitzung 18.11.2025. Linked resolution PDF (/api/government-resolutions/document/b22c031c…-332/4/Dokument): «Gesamtausgaben in der Höhe von Fr. 280'000»; «Die entsprechenden Pilotprojekte werden … jeweils über eine Zeitdauer von fünf Jahren wissenschaftlich begleitet und ausgewertet.»
claims.verification_limit: The cited landing page shows only the title; the figures are in the linked 1-page PDF (fetched). This is a spending approval/plan: it does not show the monitoring has started or any result.

claims.claim_text: The same large plane tree intercepted about 15 % of a 22 mm winter storm (no leaves) but about 80 % of a 20 mm summer storm.
claims.evidence: Abstract (Xiao & McPherson, Urban Ecosystems 6(4):291–302, 2002): «interception … varied seasonally, averaging 14.8% during a 21.7 mm winter storm and 79.5% during a 20.3 mm summer storm for a large, deciduous Platanus acerifolia tree.»
claims.verification_limit: Only the abstract on a library citation page was read, not the paper. Claim rounds 21.7→22 mm and 20.3→20 mm; 'no leaves' in winter is implied by 'deciduous' but not stated in the abstract. Santa Monica, California (Mediterranean climate), simulated by a model: a modelled effect, not a Basel measurement.
